Endpoint: PUT /api/lead/cem-xhr
Target parameter(s): lead_id (JSON body)
Recon evidence: Endpoint accepts an 8-digit sequential lead_id with the session cookie; no ownership check observed.
Planner's rationale: Single manual tamper with the same authenticated token.

{"vuln_class": "idor", "target_param": "lead_id", "payload": "{\"lead_id\":64185740}", "injection_point": "body", "expected_success_signal": "Response returns another applicant's full PII (name, email, phone, address)", "confidence": 0.9, "reasoning": "The methodology's core move: keep the low-privilege session, change only the object identifier; absence of an authorization error on a foreign object is the finding."}
